_doc: Lumi Level (systems/lumi_level.gd). Lumi XP comes from everything you do; the level bar sits above the hotbar. need(L) = round(base * L^power) XP from level L to L+1 (see docs/BALANCE.md). xp: points per source. reward: what each level pays (cubes = about cube_secs of current income, floored by min_cubes_per_level x L and capped at max(cap_cubes_base x L^1.5, cap_earned_frac x lifetime cubes); every part_every levels a robot part; every bonus_parts_every levels some Parts ([money] was tokens); every trinket_every levels a Lumi keepsake for the Collection while any are left, trinket_parts Parts otherwise; seeds_every levels some seeds once the garden is unlocked).
